result.title: A Production-Grade, High-Efficiency Agentic RL Framework for Frontier LLMs with Validated Recipes
result.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a critical phase in the post-training pipeline of large language models (LLMs). As the frontier of LLM capabilities shifts from static reasoning to agentic tasks--characterized by external tool invocation, multi-turn interactions, and long-horizon decision-making--existing mainstream RL frameworks have grown increasingly unwieldy, raising the overhead of adoption, usage, and debugging. To address these challenges, we present LoongSage, an agent-native, fully asynchronous RL framework with a lightweight core of roughly 14K lines of code. Built upon Megatron for distributed training and SGLang for high-throughput inference, LoongSage centralizes orchestration within a single controller process and encapsulates all GPU-resident components as Ray actors. It introduces AgentFlow, a unified execution paradigm that orchestrates both white-box and black-box agents. For asynchronous execution, it integrates sliding-window strategies that bound trajectory staleness, and employs TransferMesh, a topology-aware synchronization mechanism that routes weights after each step over the fastest transport available to each receiver. Beyond agentic RL, LoongSage incorporates a memory-efficient Teacher Manager that decouples the scaling of teacher models from GPU memory constraints, natively supporting Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation. Extensive evaluations across four complete training runs, spanning complex reinforcement learning and multi-teacher distillation, demonstrate that task rewards improve steadily while the train-inference gap is kept under continuous control, and the fully asynchronous pipeline removes synchronous idle bubbles, sustaining hardware utilization.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LoongSage：面向 LLM 智能体任务的全异步 RL 训练框架，核心约 14K 行，包含统一白盒/黑盒智能体的 AgentFlow 执行范式、约束轨迹陈旧的滑动窗口策略、拓扑感知的 TransferMesh 权重同步，以及支持多教师 on-policy 蒸馏的 Teacher Manager，并在四次完整训练中验证奖励与硬件利用率。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文不涉及视觉细节保留或 latent 状态生成，但其轨迹级监督、陈旧度约束与多教师蒸馏的工程做法，可能可供核查 LVR 轨迹训练、贡献分配与教师监督的可靠性，属较间接的方法线索。
